title: Cash export, schema v1
description: A row of the export of a snapshot of a company's liquidity forecast to a treasury system (ADR-0051 §14, T53h). A file is one snapshot of one company: in JSON lines (`jsonl`), one object per line, each line ending in LF, in UTF-8; in CSV (`csv`, RFC 4180), a header line of the column names in the order of `x-columns`, then one line per row, each ending in CRLF, a null written as an empty field. A row is what the snapshot kept of one currency, day or bucket, house bank, source, certainty and liquidity item, summed: within 31 days of the snapshot's date one row per day (`granularity` `day`, `period_start` = `period_end`, the flows' value date at the bank), beyond it one per bucket of the company's buckets (`granularity` `bucket`). Rows are ordered by currency, period_start, period_end, house_bank_code (null first), source, certainty and liquidity_item (null first). A row names no document, supplier or payment. The file is named cash-<company_code>-<snapshot_date>-<SHA-256 of the content, hexadecimal>.<jsonl|csv>: a snapshot never changes, so the same snapshot exported again is the same file under the same name. Changes within v1 are additive (a column added at the end); anything else is v2, published beside v1.

company_code.description: The company code of the snapshot's legal entity.

snapshot_date.description: The company's date when the snapshot was taken.

snapshot_kind.description: daily (taken once a day per company) or on_demand (taken by a person). Open enumeration: values may be added within v1.

taken_at.description: When the forecast was read, in UTC (RFC 3339).

currency.description: The flows' transaction currency (ISO 4217); amount is in it.

granularity.description: day: one value date within 31 days of the snapshot's date; bucket: a bucket of the company's buckets beyond.

period_end.description: The row's last day: period_start for a day.

house_bank_code.description: The house bank the flows are expected at, by its code; null when no bank is known.

account_last4.description: The last four characters of the house bank's account; null with house_bank_code.

source.description: Where the flows come from (ADR-0051 §4), one of payable, payable_blocked (owed to a supplier no run pays), invoice_unposted, down_payment, purchase_order, payment_run, in_transit and memo. Open enumeration: values may be added within v1.

liquidity_item.description: The liquidity item's code the flows were classified in when the snapshot was taken; null when no rule assigned one.

amount.description: The flows' sum, a decimal in the currency's minor-unit digits, signed: a receipt positive, a payment negative.

flow_count.description: The forecast's flows summed in the row.
